name: opensalt-agent-skills
description: Two skills for 1EdTech CASE 1.1 and OpenSALT: case-json converts any source (text, CSV, JSON, XML, PDFs, spreadsheets, job descriptions, curricula) into a valid CASE 1.1 CFPackage; opensalt-skill authors, validates, publishes, and reads back competency frameworks against a live OpenSALT registry (item kinds, bundled validator, /api/v1 upload, CASE catalog and /uri/ markdown).
suggestedPrompts: Create a CASE 1.1 CFPackage for our robotics curriculum and validate it for distribution
Validate this CASE package and fix every error the validator reports
Upload this CFPackage to our OpenSALT registry and verify it by fetching it back
